classification.primary_role_rule: Use Gear & technology for dedicated equipment retailers; do not change the seven categories or add subtype codes.
classification.medical_rule: Ripperdocs and medical clinics remain Medical & cyberware; no medical role changes approved by this manifest.
classification.mixed_sellers_rule: Keep pawnshops, markets, fashion shops and general stores in their primary role; index their Vend-R stock departments for discovery.
classification.stock_availability: Department profile means goods the vendor can plausibly sell, not confirmed on-hand stock.
classification.id_join: Canonical exact-ID joins only, with no inferred coordinates, phantom pins or duplicated outlets.

precedence: For a new build, load current.main_locations rather than V4 for the 556 main pin classifications.
Preserve the 105 separate Vend-R outlet pins from the approved private viewer; join existing IDs, never manufacture outlets from stock profiles.
Use current.merchandise_index and current.commerce_helper to attach searchable primary/secondary stock departments to existing pins before building unified search.
Use current.primary_role_overlay as an idempotent check/adapter if the input pins still have pre-V5 roles; do not apply unrelated role changes.
Keep V4 optional tags, category colour and existing icon morphology/animations; Vend-R departments are search facets, not display tags.

legacy.v4_status: historical rollback only; not a default for new builds
